criteria.name: Professional Tone
criteria.description: Assesses whether the writing style is appropriate for professional or business communication when required.

criteria.name: Problem Solving
criteria.description: Measures how effectively the response solves the user's problem or task.

criteria.name: User Helpfulness
criteria.description: Evaluates how useful and actionable the response is for the user.

promptA: You are a customer support agent for an e-commerce store. Be professional and helpful.
promptB: You are a customer support agent for an e-commerce store. Always start by acknowledging the customer's frustration, then offer a concrete solution with a timeline. Sign off warmly.
testCases: My order was supposed to arrive 3 days ago and it still hasn't shown up. This is unacceptable.
I was charged twice for the same order. I need this fixed immediately.
The product I received looks nothing like the photos on your website. I want a refund.
I've been waiting 20 minutes on hold. Can someone actually help me?
